welcome.title: You're verified
welcome.body: Patients can now find you once you turn on "Accepting new patients". All workspace pages are open.

unverified.title: Complete verification to start seeing patients
unverified.body: Patients can't see, message or book you until your licence is verified. It usually takes {days} working days.

pending.title: We're reviewing your documents
pending.body: We'll let you know within {days} working days.

needs_more_info.title: We need a little more information
needs_more_info.body: Please read the reviewer's message, then update and resubmit.

rejected.title: Your verification wasn't approved
rejected.body: Read the reviewer's message. You can update your details and resubmit.

expired.title: Your licence has expired
expired.body: Upload your renewed licence to continue.

suspended.title: Your account is suspended
suspended.body: Patients can't see or book you while your account is suspended. GeneBridge will contact you.

locked.title: Available once you're verified
locked.body: This page shows patient information, so it opens after your licence is verified. There's nothing here yet.
locked.suspended: This page is unavailable while your account is suspended.

profile.title: Profile
profile.subtitle: Patients see your profile only once you're verified.
profile.subtitleVerified: How patients see you in the directory.
profile.photoHint: A clear photo of your face. Location data is removed.
profile.error: We couldn't save that. Try again.
profile.photoError: That photo couldn't be used. Try a JPEG or PNG.

availability.title: Availability
availability.subtitle: Set your weekly hours now. Patients see them only once you're verified.
availability.subtitleVerified: Your weekly hours. Patients book within these.

status.invalid: Each end time must be after its start time.
status.error: We couldn't save that. Try again.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Language, notifications and your licence.
settings.inApp: You'll always see updates in the app.
settings.email: Email me when my verification status changes
settings.error: We couldn't save that. Try again.

locations.title: Where you see patients
locations.body: Patients searching "Care near you" see your closest location and how far it is. Only verified professionals who are accepting patients appear.
locations.empty: No in-person locations yet. Patients can still find you in the directory and meet by video.
locations.label: Clinic or facility name
locations.findPlaceholder: Clinic name, street or city, anywhere in the world
locations.findNone: No match. Try the street and city, or paste a map point below.
locations.findError: Address search isn't available right now. Paste a map point below instead.
locations.findResults: Addresses found. Choose one to use its map point.
locations.pointHelp: Filled in when you choose an address above. You can also paste the latitude and longitude from your map app, for example 24.4539, 54.3773.
locations.invalid: Add a name and a valid map point.
locations.tooMany: You can add up to 5 locations.
locations.error: We couldn't save that. Try again.
locations.lockedNote: Patients will see your locations once you're verified and accepting patients.

kinds.pending: We received your documents and they're in review.
kinds.rejected: Your verification wasn't approved. See the reviewer's message.
kinds.expired: Your licence has expired. Upload your renewed licence.

quality.blurry: This photo looks blurry. A sharp photo is easier to check.
quality.dark: This photo looks dark. Try somewhere brighter.

capture.selfieHint: Look at the camera, face in the frame
capture.frameHint: Fit the whole document in the frame
capture.full: That's the most pages for this document.
capture.cameraDenied: The camera isn't available. You can upload a photo instead.

problems.file_type: Use a JPEG or PNG photo (or a PDF for your licence).
problems.file_too_large: That file is over 10 MB. Try a smaller photo.
problems.heic_unsupported: This browser can't read HEIC photos. Save it as JPEG and try again.
problems.unreadable: We couldn't read that file. Try another photo.

details.title: Licence details
details.body: As printed on your professional licence.

licence.title: Photograph your professional licence
licence.body: Your licence card or certificate. Add more pages if it has them.
licence.hint: Lay it flat in good light. All four corners should be visible.

id.title: Photograph your government ID
id.body: Emirates ID or passport: the front, and the back if it has one.
id.hint: We only use your ID to confirm it's you. It's deleted after the decision.

selfie.title: Take a selfie (optional, recommended)
selfie.body: A reviewer compares it with your ID photo. It speeds up verification.
selfie.hint: Plain background, face clearly visible, no sunglasses.

review.title: Review and submit
review.counts: {licence, plural, one {# licence page} other {# licence pages}}, {id, plural, one {# ID side} other {# ID sides}}, {selfie, plural, =0 {no selfie} other {selfie}}
review.privacy: Your documents are encrypted and seen only by the GeneBridge reviewer. They're deleted once a decision is made; we keep only the outcome, your licence number and expiry date.
review.consent: I confirm these documents are mine and accurate, and I agree to GeneBridge verifying them.

errors.authorityOther: Enter the name of the issuing authority.
errors.expiry: Enter an expiry date in the future.
errors.licence: Add a photo of your licence.
errors.id: Add a photo of the front of your ID.

failure.upload: A document didn't send. Check your connection and try again.
failure.not_allowed: You already have a submission in review, or verification isn't available for your account right now.
failure.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

flow.verifiedBody: There's nothing to do here. When your licence is renewed, we'll ask for the new one.
flow.suspendedBody: Your account is suspended. GeneBridge will contact you.

submission.title: Your submission
submission.sentBody: We'll let you know within {days} working days. You'll get a notification when it's decided.
submission.documentsNote: Your documents are encrypted and can't be viewed here. Only the reviewer can open them, and they're deleted after the decision.
